title: Build an answerable experiment record
description: Choose a training workflow and capture evidence. The lab shows which production questions the resulting run can actually answer.

workflows.label: Notebook comparison
workflows.detail: A practitioner compares a few feature and parameter choices before automation.

workflows.label: Scheduled retraining
workflows.detail: A repeatable pipeline trains, evaluates, and packages one candidate on new data.

workflows.label: Distributed parameter search
workflows.detail: Many child trials must remain comparable to one parent search and one data snapshot.

organizations.label: One experiment per run
organizations.detail: Every execution creates a new experiment container.

organizations.label: Experiment per ML task
organizations.detail: Runs share a task-level experiment and stable searchable tags.

organizations.label: One experiment for the whole team
organizations.detail: Unrelated tasks share a container and depend heavily on tag discipline.

fields.label: Parameters
fields.detail: Training and preprocessing choices used by this execution.
fields.question: What configuration produced the result?

fields.label: Metrics
fields.detail: Named measurements with step or timestamp context.
fields.question: How did candidate runs compare?

fields.label: Dataset reference
fields.detail: Source, digest, schema, and training or evaluation context.
fields.question: Which data snapshot trained the model?

fields.label: Code version
fields.detail: Commit or immutable build identity, not a mutable branch name.
fields.question: Which code path produced the artifact?

fields.label: Environment lock
